assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, and engineering constraints remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Statutory intensity, building, road, and infrastructure conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: The repository overall and key-area polygons are provisional and may be replaced.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, partitions, and diagrams must be recalculated after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: No site visit or informed resident, worker, business, or operator interview has been completed.
assumptions.impact: No physical pilot advances beyond G0 until G1 fieldwork and operator confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The provisional Dazhongsi key-area polygon may be spatially inconsistent with its label.
assumptions.impact: Only function and adjacency are proposed; no station, parcel, or property anchoring is asserted.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual building envelopes are not surveyed existing buildings or approved footprints.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish and height decisions require inventory, appraisal, ownership, heritage, fire, and daylight review.

assumptions.statement: Housing-land share is a comparative design scenario rather than a statutory or supply target.
assumptions.impact: Professional work must test tenure, affordability, service capacity, and resident benefit before any allocation.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios require minimum-data design, human alternatives, staffed operation, and stop conditions.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is an approved deployment; high-impact decisions remain human and legally accountable.

assumptions.statement: Phases describe evidence gates rather than committed dates, budgets, or government programmes.
assumptions.impact: Expansion occurs only after the prior gate is documented and reviewed.
